name: certscore-website-privacy-preflight
description: Evidence-backed public-website privacy preflight with eligible bounded post-refusal cookie and tracker review.

interface.longDescription: Use CertScore.ai MCP Light to run or reuse a bounded public-website scan and summarize persisted evidence about cookies, trackers, consent controls, policy signals, HTTPS/TLS, and—on eligible sites—non-essential cookie or tracker activity observed after a confirmed Reject action. Results preserve provenance and explicit coverage limitations for human review.
defaultPrompt: Run a privacy preflight for this public website.
Review this vendor website's observable privacy signals.
Check this launch URL for cookies, trackers, consent signals, and eligible post-refusal observations.
